# surfaces

PTY bridge, xterm pane, the ephemeral shell surface, sizing, one live client per target.

- Spec: `docs/features/surfaces/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/surfaces/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/terminal*.go
go: internal/server/shells*.go
go: internal/server/plainshell_test.go
go: internal/server/settings_shell_test.go
go: internal/termbridge/**
go: internal/tmux/**
web: web/src/features/surfaces.ts
web: web/src/terminal/**
e2e: web/e2e/terminal.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/shell.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/plain-shell.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/terminal.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/shell.ts
```

## Protocol

- `terminal.ws` — WebSocket `/ws/terminal/{id}` — the PTY bridge
- `terminal.shell-ws` — WebSocket `/ws/shell/{id}` — the shell PTY bridge
- `sessions.shell` — `POST /api/sessions/{id}/shell`

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/drop-daemon-locates-original-never-stages` — Dropping a file on a live pane types the original file's escaped path: the daemon locates it on disk by name, size and bytes, or types nothing; never a copy. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: drop, surfaces) → `docs/adr/drop-daemon-locates-original-never-stages.md`
- `kb:adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal` — A pointer click on a rail card puts keyboard focus in that session's terminal; keyboard activation, number chords and the Tiles strip only select. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: focus, rail, surfaces) → `docs/adr/focus-rail-click-focuses-terminal.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-frontend-web-app-served-by-daemon` — The frontend is a daemon-served web app with interactive terminal panes in an app window; TUI, Gio, Fyne, Electron and a read-only side dashboard lost. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: connection, surfaces) → `docs/adr/stack-frontend-web-app-served-by-daemon.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-terminal-backing-tmux` — Sessions run the real claude CLI inside tmux on a dedicated socket; the Agent SDK and bare daemon-owned PTYs were rejected. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/stack-terminal-backing-tmux.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-terminal-rendering-xterm-js` — Terminal panes render with xterm.js; a Go-side VT emulation with a canvas renderer was rejected for v1 because it reimplements selection, scrollback and copy. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces) → `docs/adr/stack-terminal-rendering-xterm-js.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-websocket-coder` — WebSockets use coder/websocket; the stdlib has none, x/net/websocket is deprecated, and Echo would wrap a third-party library anyway. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: connection, surfaces) → `docs/adr/stack-websocket-coder.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-detach-on-destroy-on` — Muster's tmux server runs detach-on-destroy on; the spike's off setting hops a client to another session and misroutes keystrokes. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: surfaces) → `docs/adr/surfaces-detach-on-destroy-on.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-attach-target` — The one-live-client law is per attach target, not per session: a session's Claude socket and shell socket coexist and never supersede each other. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-attach-target.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-tmux-session-per-session` — Each Muster session is its own tmux session, named muster-<id>, because a tmux client attaches to a session and Tiles needs several live at once. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-tmux-session-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-scroll-speed-via-launch-env` — Wheel scrolling moves five lines per notch through an undocumented Claude Code environment variable in the launch and resume env, guarded by the canary. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: surfaces, launch) → `docs/adr/surfaces-scroll-speed-via-launch-env.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shared-attach-single-pty` — Display is one daemon-owned PTY attached to tmux and fanned out; sizing drives both pty.Setsize and resize-window, never resize-pane or capture-pane polling. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shared-attach-single-pty.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-control-in-tile-footer` — The tile's surface control lives in the footer action row, not the specced header, because a header control truncated every title at the dense grid. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, tiles) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-control-in-tile-footer.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-is-attach-target-not-session` — A session may carry an ephemeral plain shell as a second attach target; the shell is not a session, no row, card, state or wire kind, forgotten on restart. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-is-attach-target-not-session.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-lifetime-until-exit-remove-or-reconcile` — A shell outlives End and view switches and can open on a dead session; it dies on exit, Remove or reconcile, which kills every shell rather than adopting. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, lifecycle, actions) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-lifetime-until-exit-remove-or-reconcile.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-pane-carries-no-session-env` — The shell pane carries no Muster session environment and gets no settings written, so a nested Claude Code fires hooks that persist unrouted. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, ingest) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-pane-carries-no-session-env.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-shell-spawn-http-then-attach-ws` — A shell is spawned lazily by an HTTP post and attached over a second socket that never spawns, so a spawn failure has a body the dashboard can render. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: surfaces, connection) → `docs/adr/surfaces-shell-spawn-http-then-attach-ws.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-tmux-preflight-at-startup` — tmux is a hard dependency checked by a bounded preflight before the data dir or listener exists; a missing or broken tmux is fatal with the remedy on stderr. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: surfaces, connection) → `docs/adr/surfaces-tmux-preflight-at-startup.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-unrecognised-tmux-version-warns` — The stated minimum tmux is the version whose features the tmux package uses; a version string that runs but does not parse is a warning, not fatal. (accepted, 2026-08-31; features: surfaces) → `docs/adr/surfaces-unrecognised-tmux-version-warns.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-shell-pip-own-token` — The running-shell pip gets its own token in every theme rather than reusing teal, which is reserved for Working; no exemption is recorded. (accepted, 2026-09-05; features: theme, surfaces) → `docs/adr/theme-shell-pip-own-token.md`
- `kb:adr/theme-terminal-ground-follows-claude-family` — The terminal pane ground always follows Claude Code's theme family, override or not; each theme supplies a light and a dark terminal pair. (accepted, 2026-09-02; features: theme, surfaces) → `docs/adr/theme-terminal-ground-follows-claude-family.md`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/scroll-speed-env-present` — CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED is present in the installed bundle; the static canary tier asserts every LaunchEnv key by byte string. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.267; features: launch, surfaces) → `docs/facts/scroll-speed-env-present.md`

## Lessons

- `kb:lesson/detach-on-destroy-misrouted-keystrokes` — A spike value measured under one tmux topology was carried into the plan that replaced it; killing one session sent keys to another's claude. (active, 2026-08-23; features: surfaces) → `docs/lessons/detach-on-destroy-misrouted-keystrokes.md`
- `kb:lesson/resize-pane-silent-noop` — tmux resize-pane exits 0 and does nothing on a single-pane window; sizing needs pty.Setsize and resize-window together, measured zero-diff at five widths. (active, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces) → `docs/lessons/resize-pane-silent-noop.md`
- `kb:lesson/tiles-never-refit-behind-pattern-match` — No tile ever sent a resize frame while footers pattern-matched geometry and passed; five Criticals lived in the second view the plan's source states omitted. (active, 2026-08-23; features: tiles, surfaces) → `docs/lessons/tiles-never-refit-behind-pattern-match.md`
- `kb:lesson/transient-display-is-not-an-oracle` — E12 flaked for weeks on a ~25 ms overlay a later render pass destroys; assert the settled state and prove a flake fix with e2e-soak, not one green run. (active, 2026-09-11; features: surfaces) → `docs/lessons/transient-display-is-not-an-oracle.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session` — A session is live on exactly one surface at one geometry at a time; every other rendering of it is a static snapshot. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-window-per-session` — Each session runs in its own tmux window inside one shared tmux session; sizing is a window-level operation. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, lifecycle) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-window-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-scrollback-affordance-not-built` — No scrollbar or copy-mode surface for panes: Claude Code runs on the alternate screen by itself, so there is no buffer to scroll; tmux is not the cause. (rejected, 2026-09-03; features: surfaces) → `docs/adr/surfaces-scrollback-affordance-not-built.md`
